- Next steps (can we confirm):
  1) Who owns purchase authority for vendor spend above $75k (name + email)?
  2) Please share the procurement email/contact and any PO template or timelines we should expect.
  3) Security: your team asked for SOC 2 and a short list of controls we map to data access and retention — I'll attach a SOC2 executive summary and our pricing sheet for the pilot.

If you can loop in the budget owner (or let me know I should reach out directly), I’ll propose a short mutual action plan that includes pilot scope, acceptance criteria, and procurement steps.

Available for a 30-minute slotted call tomorrow morning PST if you want to triage procurement and a quick intro to the budget owner.

Connor — great summary, thank you. A couple quick answers and requests: 

1) Purchase authority: Rajiv Menon is the finance director who signs off on vendor commitments > $75k (cc'd). He handles final PO sign-off but will delegate negotiations to procurement.
2) Procurement: procurement@kestrelops.com is the team — they will need a pricing sheet, SOW template (if applicable), and SOC 2 evidence.
3) Security: we run a light security review first (SOC2 + data flow diagram). If that looks good, we bring in our security team for a short questionnaire.

Can you provide a short single-sheet that maps the SOC2 controls you claim to the specific data flows for the pilot? That will speed our review. Also please indicate whether Redwood supports a limited-data-retention mode for pilot logs (preferably 30 days).

I’ve penciled in a 30-minute slot for Fri 10am PT to introduce you to Rajiv and the procurement lead — if that works for you.
